svg.title: Allocate a $75,000 Startup Budget Before Quoting Capacity
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-four-bucket-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $75,000 Startup Budget Before Quoting Capacity; subtitle: Four non-overlapping buckets sit inside the canonical $25,000–$100,000 USD startup range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Render one stacked $75,000 startup allocation with four segments. Numeric values are dollars, not annual expenses or scenario revenue. This selected budget does not imply that every operation needs the same proportions. Additional deployment capacity requires documented capital commitments; undrawn commitments and credit limits are not startup cash.; caption: $40,000 + $15,000 + $10,000 + $10,000 = $75,000. Only $40,000 is initially designated for deployment. Committed external capital and actual repayment timing must support any larger transaction volume.; stages: label: Deployable risk capital; value: $40,000 remains available for approved escrow funding.; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Represent 53.33% of startup cash as deployable capital. Set per-file and aggregate exposure limits below available liquidity after outstanding wires. Returning principal replenishes capacity; it does not create recognized operator revenue.; label: Operating runway; value: $15,000 supports recurring operations before reliable fee collections.; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Represent 20.00% of startup cash as operating runway. At the illustrative $5,350 monthly Base-Case overhead allocation, this covers about 2.8 months of overhead only, not capital carry or every contractor charge. A four-month first-deal interval requires additional runway or lower initial burn.; label: Documentation and control setup; value: $10,000 funds jurisdiction work and secure operating setup.; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Represent 13.33% of startup cash as a setup budget for applicable licensing work, transaction documents, insurance placement, secure intake, hardware security keys, and restricted bank permissions. Obtain actual quotes before committing deployment capacity.; label: Contingency and liquidity reserve; value: $10,000 stays uncommitted for delays and operating shocks.; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Represent 13.33% of startup cash as a segregated liquidity reserve. Do not count it simultaneously as committed loan funding. Reserve cash does not replace the annual loss-expense assumption or make a disputed escrow release acceptable.

text.title: Allocate a $75,000 Startup Budget Before Quoting Capacity
text.tspan: Allocate a $75,000 Startup Budget Before Quoting

rect.title: label: Deployable risk capital; numeric value: 40000.0; value: $40,000 remains available for approved escrow funding.; detail: Represent 53.33% of startup cash as deployable capital. Set per-file and aggregate exposure limits below available liquidity after outstanding wires. Returning principal replenishes capacity; it does not create recognized operator revenue.

text.title: Deployable risk capital: $40,000 remains available for approved escrow funding.
text.tspan: Deployable risk capital: $40,000 remains available for approved escrow funding.

rect.title: label: Operating runway; numeric value: 15000.0; value: $15,000 supports recurring operations before reliable fee collections.; detail: Represent 20.00% of startup cash as operating runway. At the illustrative $5,350 monthly Base-Case overhead allocation, this covers about 2.8 months of overhead only, not capital carry or every contractor charge. A four-month first-deal interval requires additional runway or lower initial burn.

text.title: Operating runway: $15,000 supports recurring operations before reliable fee collections.
text.tspan: Operating runway: $15,000 supports recurring operations before reliable fee collections.

rect.title: label: Documentation and control setup; numeric value: 10000.0; value: $10,000 funds jurisdiction work and secure operating setup.; detail: Represent 13.33% of startup cash as a setup budget for applicable licensing work, transaction documents, insurance placement, secure intake, hardware security keys, and restricted bank permissions. Obtain actual quotes before committing deployment capacity.

rect.title: label: Contingency and liquidity reserve; numeric value: 10000.0; value: $10,000 stays uncommitted for delays and operating shocks.; detail: Represent 13.33% of startup cash as a segregated liquidity reserve. Do not count it simultaneously as committed loan funding. Reserve cash does not replace the annual loss-expense assumption or make a disputed escrow release acceptable.
